{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Floor-skimming A-line dress, deep sage green (#3F6B5C), pure silk satin-crepe, fitted bodice with a defined waist, wide straps, and a softly V-shaped neckline, with bare arms as the only open zone

Block-heel sandals, closed heel with an ankle strap, 6 cm heel, warm champagne gold (#C8A97E), soft nappa leather

Clutch, small envelope shape, warm champagne gold (#C8A97E), matte silk with a thin metal clasp

Drop earrings, slim teardrop shape, polished gold tone (#D4AF6A), metal with small freshwater pearls

Thin bangle, polished gold tone (#D4AF6A), metal

Why this outfit works: The deep sage green echoes the soft green of your eyes and sets off your golden hair and warm skin, and it stays well away from white and ivory, which belong to the bride. A silk satin-crepe floor-length dress meets the formal dress code for a close family member at the wedding, while the bare arms keep you cool at an outdoor ceremony in August sunlight. Block heels hold steady on grass and keep you comfortable through the move to the restaurant, and the champagne gold accessories add a quiet shine that carries from daylight into the evening.
